note: Frozen before any contrast between study groups was examined. Do not edit; any later change is a documented deviation.

location_effect.definition: Delta = (median_B - median_A) / s_aspect, per aspect x subject cell, main prompts only
location_effect.s_aspect: sqrt of the mean, over all cells (group x subject) of the 12 open configurations G01-G12 with the aspect not implied by the subject (prompts.EXCLUDED), of the within-cell sample variance (ddof=1) of that aspect's CLIP score; computed once after all 12 groups are generated and scored, then frozen; not recomputed when groups are hidden or added
location_effect.same_place: the 90% interval of Delta lies entirely within [-0.5, 0.5] (equivalence)

concentration_effect.definition: log(IQR_B / IQR_A), per aspect x subject cell
concentration_effect.same_spread: the 90% interval of the log ratio lies entirely within [-log 1.5, log 1.5]

uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap: subjects resampled within categories; whole image score vectors resampled within groups, keeping seed pairing within a checkpoint
primary_tests: Q1 only: median Delta and median log IQR ratio across subjects, per family (klein-base 4B G07->G06, Qwen-Image-2512 G10->G09) and retained aspect; corrected together (Holm)
